exemplars.title: VISAR: A Human-AI Argumentative Writing Assistant with Visual Programming and Rapid Draft Prototyping
exemplars.why: VISAR is the clearest canonical exemplar: a text editor and visual canvas concurrently expose the same argumentative outline, both permit editing, and the system explicitly synchronizes changes between them.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It edges out GUI DE because its linguistic and spatial views are more genuinely distinct peer representations of a complex artifact, making the pattern’s broader design value especially legible.

exemplars.title: The Command Line GUIde: Graphical Interfaces from Man Pages via AI
exemplars.why: GUI DE provides unusually complete evidence of the closed loop: typing a command updates the graphical option state live, while manipulating those graphical controls edits the command.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above Charagraph because the evidence names the concrete user action and resulting update in each direction, making the synchronization mechanism more reconstructable.

exemplars.title: Charagraph: Interactive Generation of Charts for Realtime Annotation of Data-Rich Paragraphs
exemplars.why: Charagraph directly matches the structural signature: text annotations and a chart are simultaneously interactive representations, and modifications made in either are reflected in the other.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above CrossLit because its evidence explicitly states that both representations are interactive and that propagation operates in both directions, whereas CrossLit’s visual-to-text editability is less fully specified.

notes: The final selection follows the consensus top three; I found no structural reason to reorder them. All three quotes explicitly establish peer editable representations and bidirectional propagation, while the next candidate, CrossLit, leaves the visual-to-text side somewhat less explicit. The scores therefore retain the consensus means without adjustments. Readers should distrust any inference about measured user impact, conflict resolution, round-trip fidelity, or implementation through a literal shared model: the supplied evidence establishes interface behavior but reports no outcome results and does not describe reconciliation internals.
